scope: Mario, Luigi and Dr. Mario default-costume native integration and limited Battlefield workloads; full competitive acceptance remains incomplete
limitations: Draw submissions and CPU costs are measured, not distinct display presentations or physical input latency.
Default costumes and selected moves only; full retail frame parity, additional matchups/stages and costumes remain.
Contact fixtures use original default damage rules and controller-owned fighters, not a complete VS scene.
Reflected shooter damage includes any cape contact; ownership transfer is checked separately.
Live workload uses ordinary attacks/shields; projectile and special-move interactions are separate probes.
Full roster, scenes, audio, deployment and multiplayer integration remain incomplete.
toolchain: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 5.0.7 (263db4cffa6f9fc2ec514a70abac81362ea41849)
hardware: AMD Radeon 890M (radeonsi gfx1150 LLVM 20.1.2), Chrome ANGLE hardware WebGL2
noIsoStartup: Hosted assets loaded automatically by the development static fixture; no player file picker
camera: Original native camera callbacks and 4:3 framing retained; projectile/cape screenshots visually inspected
